senses.gloss: f. (preced.; cmp. גָּשׁוֹשָׁא) sounding tube; ג׳ ובת ג׳ a large and small tube, i.e. a siphon.
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 72b:9">Ab. Zar. 72ᵇ</cite> <he>אסיק חמרא בג׳</he> brought up wine through the siphon.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 72b:9">Ib.</cite> a gentile came and put his hand <cite ref="A01150"><he>אג׳</he></cite> on the large tube.
